interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clk, reset, d[7:0], q[7:0]); q captures d or reset value on each falling edge without additional latency or ports.
static_review: Explicit 8-bit reset constant, nonblocking sequential assignments, one output driver, and exact specified interface and reset semantics.
